summary: Once per turn, Fire damage dealt to you by another creature grants 2 turns of Heat.

fields.Heat: Heat deals 1d4 Fire damage to you each turn and can stack up to 7 turns. Heat Convergence consumes the stack to add 1 Fire damage per remaining turn when you next deal Fire damage.
fields.Base value: 65 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Fervent Flames: Once per turn, gain 2 turns of Heat when another creature deals Fire damage to you.
